title: Kindling recipe
description: kindling.json in a recipe folder (<model>/<hardware>/<count>x/<variant>/). tools/build_index.py validates it and copies it into index.json, which the Kindling site renders. Keys not listed here are allowed and passed through.

id.description: Stable slug: the image name, the site's card id, the CLI argument (npx @kindlingai/recipe <id>) and the prefix of this recipe's tags. Recipes adopted from their own repo keep that repo's name.

status.description: experimental and wip get an Experimental tag on the site; retired is left out of the site; external means the recipe lives in source.repo and this folder holds only its card data.

variant.description: Short description of the build, e.g. exlr8 bit201, int4 KV

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the recipe does

weights_commit.description: Hugging Face commit of the checkpoint the recipe boots

image.description: The recipe's own image, without a tag, for recipes with a Dockerfile. compose.yaml must default to it.

build.description: Present when CI builds and pushes the recipe's image (.github/workflows/recipe-image.yml). The recipe's smoke.sh tests the built image.

nvcc_cache.description: Id of the gr8 compile cache kept between runs, e.g. flash-int4-w1. Omit when the Dockerfile has no engine cache mount.

engine.description: The engine the recipe runs. tools/check_pin.py keeps it in agreement with compose.yaml and the Dockerfile.

commit.description: Full commit hash; empty only while a release is pending

pin.description: image: compose.yaml runs the engine's published image, pinned by digest. source: the recipe's Dockerfile builds from the engine's source at commit (tools/engine.sh checks it out into <recipe>/gr8).

source.description: status external only: where the recipe lives. tools/sync_external.py refreshes this file from there.

hidden.description: Leave the card off the site

order.description: Lower sorts first; recipes without it follow, by path

default_config.description: id of the config shown first; its nodes must equal the folder's count

decode.description: Single-stream decode tok/s by workload. code, prose and structured are shown in that order; other keys follow.

prefill.description: Cold prefill tok/s at a prompt length
